t: A palm sized robot for early elementary students that codes with cards or blocks.
steps: Find VEX 123 on the VEX site.
Start with Coder Cards and no device.
Install VEXcode 123 or open code123.vex.com in Chrome.
Read the VEX software privacy policy before students use VEXcode.
Connect a robot and run a first block program.
Install the VEX Classroom App to manage firmware.
